verdict:
**THE LADDER DECLINES AT PIPE 2 — it is not flat, it falls.** Lowest-minus-highest temperature deltas across the three B seeds: [-9.5, -42.0, -19.5] pp, **negative in all three**, plus -32.0 pp at R. Sharpening does not merely fail to help; **it makes clearance worse, monotonically.** So sharpening joins the A-cap on the dead list and argmax's x=916 was a lucky path at the far end of a DOWNWARD trend, not the visible end of an upward one — which is a stronger negative than the directive's third branch anticipated.

**But the behaviour statistics move the OTHER way, monotonically.** As T falls, A rate, jump starts per 1,000 and airborne fraction all march toward the expert's (0.152 / 27.5 / 61.1%) while clearance falls. **Statistical resemblance to the expert and competence are moving in opposite directions here**, which retires expert-likeness of the button marginals as a proxy for skill.
